goal: Create a network scanning tool that can discover devices on a network and identify open ports
acceptance_criteria: The tool must be able to scan IP ranges using CIDR notation
It should support scanning specific ports or port ranges
All socket operations must have proper error handling
DNS resolution must work correctly for hostnames
Results should be output in JSON format
The tool must handle timeouts gracefully
Input validation for hosts and ports is required
Logging functionality must be implemented for debugging
